open.statement: theorem leaf_coprime_selected (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 3 / 2) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ → ∃ κ₀ : ℝ, 0 < κ₀ ∧ ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ κ₀ → ∃ c A : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (r : ℝ) ≤ F γ N ^ (6 * δ) → SelectedRealZero a (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) r → ∀ j : ℤ, (j = 0 ∨ j = 1) → ∀ n ∈ window γ N, Even (nu γ n + j) → ((nu γ n + j : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ F γ N → r ≠ 1 → Int.gcd (nu γ n + j) r = 1 → c * F γ N ≤ (R1 (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N) (nu γ n + j)).re + A * F γ N * divisorError r (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (nu γ n + j)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.UpJ200.Decomp559b.leaf_prime_product_selected
open.statement: theorem leaf_prime_product_selected (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 3 / 2) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ → ∃ κ₀ : ℝ, 0 < κ₀ ∧ ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ κ₀ → ∃ c A : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (r : ℝ) ≤ F γ N ^ (6 * δ) → SelectedRealZero a (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) r → ∀ j : ℤ, (j = 0 ∨ j = 1) → ∀ n ∈ window γ N, Even (nu γ n + j) → ((nu γ n + j : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ F γ N → 1 < Int.gcd (nu γ n + j) r → (∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ r ∧ 3 < p ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ nu γ n + j) → c * F γ N ≤ (R1 (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N) (nu γ n + j)).re + A * F γ N * divisorError r (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (nu γ n + j)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.UpJ200.Decomp559b.leaf_near_zero_selected
open.statement: theorem leaf_near_zero_selected (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 3 / 2) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ → ∃ κ₀ : ℝ, 0 < κ₀ ∧ ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ ≤ κ₀ → ∃ c A : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (r : ℝ) ≤ F γ N ^ (6 * δ) → SelectedRealZero a (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) r → ∀ j : ℤ, (j = 0 ∨ j = 1) → ∀ n ∈ window γ N, Even (nu γ n + j) → ((nu γ n + j : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ F γ N → 1 < Int.gcd (nu γ n + j) r → (¬ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ r ∧ 3 < p ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ nu γ n + j) → (r : ℝ) ≤ calE γ κ N ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) → c * F γ N * calE γ κ N ^ (-(1 / 10 : ℝ)) ≤ (R1 (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N) (nu γ n + j)).re + A * F γ N * divisorError r (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (nu γ n + j)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.sobolev_pointwise
open.statement: theorem sobolev_pointwise {f f' : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) (hf' : ContinuousOn f' (Set.Icc a b)) : ‖f ((a + b) / 2)‖ ≤ (b - a)⁻¹ * ∫ t in a..b, ‖f t‖ + (1 / 2) * ∫ t in a..b, ‖f' t‖

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.hasDerivAt_trig
open.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_trig (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (trig s a) (trigDeriv s a α) α

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.parseval_trig
open.statement: theorem parseval_trig (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) : ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖trig s a α‖ ^ 2 = ∑ n ∈ s, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.integral_norm_mul_deriv_le
open.statement: theorem integral_norm_mul_deriv_le (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (K : ℕ) (hs : s ⊆ Finset.Icc (-(K : ℤ)) K) : ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖trig s a α‖ * ‖trigDeriv s a α‖ ≤ 2 * π * K * ∑ n ∈ s, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.periodic_disjoint_sum
open.statement: theorem periodic_disjoint_sum {ι : Type*} (pts : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hsp : Spaced pts x δ) {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (hg0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t) (hper : ∀ t, g (t + 1) = g t) : ∑ r ∈ pts, ∫ t in (x r - δ / 2)..(x r + δ / 2), g t ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g t

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.shift_trig
open.statement: theorem shift_trig (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (c : ℤ) (α : ℝ) : trig s a α * e (-((c : ℝ) * α)) = trig (s.image (· - c)) (fun n => a (n + c)) α

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.large_sieve_centered
open.statement: theorem large_sieve_centered {ι : Type*} (pts : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hsp : Spaced pts x δ) (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (K : ℕ) (hs : s ⊆ Finset.Icc (-(K : ℤ)) K) : ∑ r ∈ pts, ‖trig s a (x r)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * π * K + δ⁻¹) * ∑ n ∈ s, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.spaced_count_le
open.statement: theorem spaced_count_le {ι : Type*} (pts : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hsp : ∀ r ∈ pts, ∀ s ∈ pts, r ≠ s → δ ≤ |x r - x s|) (u L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) : ((pts.filter (fun r => x r ∈ Set.Icc u (u + L))).card : ℝ) ≤ L / δ + 1

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.farey_spaced
open.statement: theorem farey_spaced (Q : ℕ) : Spaced (fareyPts Q) (fun p => (p.2 : ℝ) / p.1) ((Q : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.duality
open.statement: theorem duality {ι κ : Type*} (R : Finset ι) (Nn : Finset κ) (c : ι → κ → ℂ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (h : ∀ u : κ → ℂ, ∑ r ∈ R, ‖∑ n ∈ Nn, c r n * u n‖ ^ 2 ≤ D * ∑ n ∈ Nn, ‖u n‖ ^ 2) (v : ι → ℂ) : ∑ n ∈ Nn, ‖∑ r ∈ R, c r n * v r‖ ^ 2 ≤ D * ∑ r ∈ R, ‖v r‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.char_mul_tau
open.statement: theorem char_mul_tau {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (n : ℤ) : χ (n : ZMod q) * tau χ⁻¹ = ∑ b ∈ Finset.range q, χ⁻¹ (b : ZMod q) * e ((b : ℝ) * n / q)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.norm_tau_sq
open.statement: theorem norm_tau_sq {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) : ‖tau χ‖ ^ 2 = q

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.char_orthogonality_sum
open.statement: theorem char_orthogonality_sum {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (z : ℕ → ℂ) : ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖∑ b ∈ Finset.range q, χ (b : ZMod q) * z b‖ ^ 2 = (Nat.totient q : ℝ) * ∑ b ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun b => Nat.Coprime b q), ‖z b‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524a.mult_large_sieve
open.statement: theorem mult_large_sieve {Q : ℕ} (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) (M : ℤ) (N : ℕ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) : ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, ((q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q) * ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q with χ.IsPrimitive, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), a n * χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (π * N + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.S_split_residue
open.statement: theorem S_split_residue {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (a : ℤ) (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : S N ((a : ℝ) / q + η) = ∑ b ∈ Finset.range q, e ((a : ℝ) * b / q) * ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => n % q = b), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) * e (n * η)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.nonCoprime_vonMangoldt_le
open.statement: theorem nonCoprime_vonMangoldt_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => ¬ Nat.Coprime n q), Λ n ≤ (q.primeFactors.card : ℝ) * Real.log N

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.abel_bound
open.statement: theorem abel_bound (c : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (η B : ℝ) (h : ∀ m ≤ N, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, c n‖ ≤ B) : ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, c n * e (n * η)‖ ≤ (1 + 2 * π * |η| * N) * B

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.ramanujan_coprime
open.statement: theorem ramanujan_coprime {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (a : ℤ) (ha : Int.gcd a q = 1) : ∑ b ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun b => Nat.Coprime b q), e ((a : ℝ) * b / q) = ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℤ) : ℂ)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.ramanujan_norm_le_gcd
open.statement: theorem ramanujan_norm_le_gcd {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (n : ℤ) : ‖∑ b ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun b => Nat.Coprime b q), e ((b : ℝ) * n / q)‖ ≤ (Int.gcd n q : ℝ)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.geom_sum_le
open.statement: theorem geom_sum_le (N : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη0 : 0 < |η|) (hη : |η| ≤ 1 / 2) : ‖T N η‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * |η|)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.gallagher_lemma
open.statement: theorem gallagher_lemma (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) : ∫ t in (-T)..T, ‖trig s a t‖ ^ 2 ≤ π ^ 2 * T ^ 2 * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖∑ n ∈ s.filter (fun n : ℤ => x < (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ x + 1 / (2 * T)), a n‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.char_expansion
open.statement: theorem char_expansion {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (a n : ℤ) (ha : Int.gcd a q = 1) (hn : Int.gcd n q = 1) : e ((a : ℝ) * n / q) = ((Nat.totient q : ℂ))⁻¹ * ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ (a : ZMod q) * χ (n : ZMod q) * tau χ⁻¹

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.tau_norm_le
open.statement: theorem tau_norm_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : ‖tau χ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt q

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524b.major_arc_approx
open.statement: theorem major_arc_approx {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (a : ℤ) (ha : Int.gcd a q = 1) (N : ℕ) (η Δ : ℝ) (hΔ : ∀ b ∈ Finset.range q, Nat.Coprime b q → ∀ m ≤ N, |psiAP m q b - (m : ℝ) / Nat.totient q| ≤ Δ) : ‖S N ((a : ℝ) / q + η) - (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℤ) : ℂ) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)) * T N η‖ ≤ Nat.totient q * (1 + 2 * π * |η| * N) * Δ + (q.primeFactors.card : ℝ) * Real.log N

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.layer_cake_sum
open.statement: theorem layer_cake_sum {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {σ₀ x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hβ : ∀ i ∈ I, σ₀ ≤ β i ∧ β i ≤ 1) : ∑ i ∈ I, x ^ (β i - 1) = x ^ (σ₀ - 1) * I.card + ∫ α in σ₀..1, Real.log x * x ^ (α - 1) * ((I.filter (fun i => α ≤ β i)).card : ℝ)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.count_integral_le
open.statement: theorem count_integral_le {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {σ₀ η x Y A : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hY : 0 < Y) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hσ : σ₀ ≤ 1 - η) (hβ : ∀ i ∈ I, σ₀ ≤ β i ∧ β i ≤ 1 - η) (hcount : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc σ₀ 1, ((I.filter (fun i => α ≤ β i)).card : ℝ) ≤ A * Y ^ (1 - α)) : ∫ α in σ₀..1, Real.log x * x ^ (α - 1) * ((I.filter (fun i => α ≤ β i)).card : ℝ) ≤ A * ∫ α in σ₀..(1 - η), Real.log x * (Y / x) ^ (1 - α)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.integral_ratio_le
open.statement: theorem integral_ratio_le {σ₀ η x Y : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hY : 0 < Y) (hYx : Y ≤ Real.sqrt x) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hσ : σ₀ ≤ 1 - η) : ∫ α in σ₀..(1 - η), Real.log x * (Y / x) ^ (1 - α) ≤ 2 * x ^ (-η / 2)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.card_chars_le
open.statement: theorem card_chars_le (Q : ℕ) : ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, (Fintype.card (DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.hybrid_large_sieve
open.statement: theorem hybrid_large_sieve : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ Q : ℕ, 1 ≤ Q → ∀ T : ℝ, 1 ≤ T → ∀ (M N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ), ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q with χ.IsPrimitive, ∫ t in (-T)..T, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), a n * χ (n : ZMod q) * (n : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * (N + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 * T) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.mollifier_coeff_one
open.statement: theorem mollifier_coeff_one {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) : ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors 1).filter (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) ≤ X), ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ) = 1

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.mollifier_coeff_vanish
open.statement: theorem mollifier_coeff_vanish {n : ℕ} {X : ℝ} (hn : 1 < n) (hnX : (n : ℝ) ≤ X) : ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors n).filter (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) ≤ X), ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ) = 0

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.mollifier_coeff_le
open.statement: theorem mollifier_coeff_le (n : ℕ) (X : ℝ) : |∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors n).filter (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) ≤ X), ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ (Nat.divisors n).card

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.Decomp1524c.spaced_subfamily
open.statement: theorem spaced_subfamily (Z : Finset ℝ) (K : ℕ) (hK : ∀ u : ℝ, (Z.filter (fun γ => γ ∈ Set.Icc u (u + 1))).card ≤ K) : ∃ Z' ⊆ Z, (∀ γ ∈ Z', ∀ γ' ∈ Z', γ ≠ γ' → 1 ≤ |γ - γ'|) ∧ Z.card ≤ 2 * K * Z'.card

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf_Q_vanish
open.statement: theorem leaf_Q_vanish (γ : ℝ) (s t : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) : Q γ s t = 0

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf_Q_top
open.statement: theorem leaf_Q_top (γ : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) : Q γ (s + 1) s = C ((q s).eval (γ - 1)) * X

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf_Q_degree
open.statement: theorem leaf_Q_degree (γ : ℝ) (s t : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (ht : t < s) : (Q γ s t).natDegree ≤ s - t ∧ (Q γ s t).coeff 0 = 0

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf_piece_hasDerivAt
open.statement: theorem leaf_piece_hasDerivAt (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (s t : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) : HasDerivAt (piece γ s t) (pieceD γ s t x) x

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf_regroup
open.statement: theorem leaf_regroup (γ : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), pieceD γ s t x = term γ (s + 1) x

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf_q_iter_deriv
open.statement: theorem leaf_q_iter_deriv (s t : ℕ) (hts : t ≤ s) (x : ℝ) (hx : (s : ℝ) ≤ x) : 0 ≤ (derivative^[t] (q s)).eval x ∧ (derivative^[t] (q s)).eval x ≤ (s : ℝ) ^ t * (q (s - t)).eval x

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf12_diag
open.statement: theorem leaf12_diag (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 2) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) : P12 γ (t + 1) t

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf12_step
open.statement: theorem leaf12_step (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 2) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (s : ℕ) (hs : t + 1 ≤ s) (hst : P12 γ s t) (hprev : ∀ s' : ℕ, t ≤ s' → P12 γ s' (t - 1)) : P12 γ (s + 1) t

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf13_E_bound
open.statement: theorem leaf13_E_bound (h12 : Lemma12) (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 2) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (x : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) (hξ : (s : ℝ) ≤ xi γ x) (hsq : (s : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log x / 2) : |∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico 1 s, (Real.log x ^ t)⁻¹ * (Q γ s t).eval (xi γ x)| ≤ 2 * (s : ℝ) ^ 2 / Real.log x * (q (s - 1)).eval (xi γ x)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf14_s_small
open.statement: theorem leaf14_s_small (γ : ℝ) (h1 : 1 < γ) (h2 : γ < 3 / 2) : ∃ x₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ x₀ ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → ∀ s : ℕ, (s : ℝ) ≤ xi γ x → (s : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log x / 4

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf14_q_tail
open.statement: theorem leaf14_q_tail (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : (s : ℝ) ≤ ξ) : 0 ≤ (q (s - 1)).eval ξ ∧ (s.factorial : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (q (s - 1)).eval ξ * (ξ - s + 1 / 2)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf15_cauchy
open.statement: theorem leaf15_cauchy (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 1 < γ) (N : ℝ) (hN : 10 ≤ N) (s : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hx1 : N ≤ x) (hx2 : x ≤ 2 * N) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - x‖ = N / 2 → ‖Fc γ z‖ ≤ M) : |iteratedDeriv s (F γ) x / s.factorial| ≤ (2 / N) ^ s * M

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf15_max
open.statement: theorem leaf15_max (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 1 < γ) (N : ℝ) (hN : 10 ≤ N) (x : ℝ) (hx1 : N ≤ x) (hx2 : x ≤ 2 * N) (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z - x‖ ≤ N / 2) : ‖Fc γ z‖ ≤ F γ (3 * N)

open.name: LeanLab.ExceptionalSet.U1539.leaf16_53
